differential.name: End-stage renal disease (CKD stage 4 on dialysis)
differential.rationale: Fluid overload and uremic symptoms common in advanced CKD explain pain and weight change post‑dialysis.

differential.name: Ischemic heart disease (unstable angina)
differential.rationale: History of CABG, diabetes, hypertension, and chest‑type pain rating 5/10 raise concern for cardiac ischemia.

differential.name: Diabetic peripheral neuropathy
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with microvascular disease often causes chronic pain rated 5/10.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: CKD‑related anemia contributes to fatigue and generalized discomfort, especially in stage 4 disease.

differential.name: Statin‑induced myopathy
differential.rationale: Dyslipidemia treatment can cause muscle pain; ALT mildly elevated supports possible drug‑related effect.
